name: execute_rizin_command
description: Execute one caller-selected Rizin command against a local artifact using the Rizin CLI profile that suppresses user settings and scripts while retaining plugins. Preserves decoded stdout and stderr inline with SHA-256 Evidence, up to a shared 16 MiB combined limit; invalid UTF-8 bytes are represented by replacement characters and flagged in Evidence limitations. output_truncated reports output beyond that limit and completion_status is unknown if buffer enforcement terminated the process. Rizin commands and retained plugins can execute foreign code, mutate files, access the network, and read files outside the selected artifact; identities and contents of those external inputs are not bound to Evidence. Command effects depend on the Rizin command and loaded plugins; JSON is command-specific and raw output remains authoritative. For a raw image, asm_arch, asm_bits and asm_cpu select the decoder and base_address maps file offset 0 there; base_address also passes -n, which skips format loaders even for an ELF, and REA confirms neither. In a shared MCP server, this admitted command closes any active binary-analysis session; after its effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first. Optional command_timeout_ms is the per-phase wall clock in milliseconds (default 120000, range 1..2147483647); omitted means 120000 and the value applies on the next call. It does not raise the 16 MiB output cap or a Rizin debugger session deadline.
